title: Crushing the witch

dating.label: Late Babylonian witnesses
dating.note: The linked witness has a Late Babylonian period label and a tentative Babylon findspot. This is manuscript context, not a date or location for the original rite.

purpose: Represent the alleged witches with figures of several materials, then crush or burn them and chew named plants.
attribution: Divine instruction attributed to Enki/Ea and Asalluḫi; the affected man performs some actions

phases.name: Prepare the figures
phases.idea: Figures of several materials are formed, constrained and placed in a pot.

phases.name: Address the sun god
phases.idea: A juniper censer and grape-must offering are placed before Utu.

phases.name: Destroy and treat
phases.idea: Different figure materials are crushed or burned, followed by named plants and woods.

steps.title: Make figures from five materials
steps.shortDescription: Fashion representations of warlock and witch from clay, dough, tallow, bitumen and wax.
steps.summary: Fashion representations of warlock and witch from clay, dough, tallow, bitumen and wax.
steps.actor: Ritual practitioner in the divine instruction
steps.evidence: The command begins in line 8′; line 9′ supplies the materials. Parts of the bilingual line are damaged or restored.
